title: Records Fall Both Ways at West Cliffs
title_candidates: Records Fall Both Ways at West Cliffs
Best of Times, Worst of Times on the Silver Coast
Mullin Soars as Patterson Sinks at West Cliffs
theme: On West Cliffs' second-ever TEG visit, the course record fell in both directions inside the same round.
opening_hook: West Cliffs has hosted exactly one previous TEG round; by the time the last putt dropped on its second, it had a new best and a new worst, set thirty-four Stableford points apart on the same afternoon.

round_story.subject: David Mullin's course-record 82 headlines a stellar West Cliffs return
round_story.why_it_matters: It is a new West Cliffs course record, the best gross round anyone has carded there across two TEGs, and it arrives from a player who was mid-table after round one - the standout performance of the day by a wide margin on both Stableford and gross.
round_story.shape: David Mullin arrives at West Cliffs off a modest opening round of 33 points. A brisk birdie-laden stretch through the 7th to 10th, followed by two closing pars, carries him to 47 points and a gross 82 that beats the previous course record by six. It is, by some distance, the best round played at West Cliffs to date.
headline_candidates: Mullin Breaks the West Cliffs Record
David Mullin Sets a New Course Mark
round_story.chosen_headline: Mullin Breaks the West Cliffs Record
round_story.standfirst: A wretched opening round is put right as David Mullin produces the best round played at this Portuguese links to date.

race_story.subject: John Patterson's collapse hands the Trophy lead to Jon Baker and drops him to the bottom of the Wooden Spoon race
race_story.why_it_matters: Patterson began the round a point clear at the top of the TEG 17 Trophy; he ends it with the heaviest gross score West Cliffs has yet recorded and seven points adrift at the foot of the TEG 17 Wooden Spoon, while a quietly excellent Jon Baker inherits the Trophy lead.
race_story.shape: Patterson starts round two one point clear of Jon Baker at the top of the Trophy. From the 8th to the 15th he goes eight holes without a net par - a quadruple bogey at the 3rd, a quintuple at the 13th and a sextuple at the 15th among them - while Jon Baker builds his round quietly around two hot stretches. Patterson's 116 gross sets a new course worst and buries him at the bottom of the Spoon table by seven, as Jon Baker moves two clear at the top of the Trophy.
headline_candidates: Patterson's Collapse Hands Jon Baker the Lead
race_story.chosen_headline: Patterson's Collapse Hands Jon Baker the Lead
race_story.standfirst: Overnight Trophy leader John Patterson loses the plot for eight holes in the middle of his round and returns the heaviest gross score West Cliffs has yet seen.

discovered_storylines.subject: Alex Baker survives two quadruple bogeys to set a new West Cliffs personal best
discovered_storylines.why_it_matters: Alex Baker began the round anchoring the TEG 17 Wooden Spoon table; despite blow-ups at the 10th and 11th he posts a new course personal best of 105 gross, five shots inside his previous mark, and hands over last place as Patterson implodes elsewhere.
discovered_storylines.shape: Alex Baker piles up 16 points through a hot stretch from the 4th to the 8th, then quadruple bogeys at the 10th and 11th threaten to derail the round entirely. A birdie at the 12th stops the bleeding, and he closes out with a new West Cliffs personal best.
headline_candidates: Two Quads Can't Stop Alex Baker
Alex Baker Survives Blow-Ups for a Course Best
discovered_storylines.chosen_headline: Two Quads Can't Stop Alex Baker
discovered_storylines.standfirst: A hot start and a defiant birdie carry Alex Baker to a new West Cliffs low despite twin quadruple bogeys in the middle of his round.

race_state_note: The Green Jacket is now a dead heat between David Mullin and Jon Baker, with Gregg Williams - the overnight leader - three shots back in third.
